results.headline: Interim Results 2026/27
results.key_quote: STRONG FINANCIAL & STRATEGIC PROGRESS WITH RECORD CUSTOMER SATISFACTION; Customers are at the heart of everything we do, and I am proud that we have achieved our highest-ever customer satisfaction score
results.summary: Tesco delivered materially strong H1 results with multiple metrics significantly exceeding performance. Group adjusted operating profit grew 6.3% at constant rates to £1,783m, with UK & ROI operating profit up 6.0% to £1,557m. Free cash flow was exceptionally strong at £1,570m (up 21.0%), and adjusted diluted EPS grew 12.2% to 17.3p. The company achieved its highest-ever customer satisfaction score. Sales grew 1.6% at constant rates with positive like-for-like growth. Tesco Media and Whoosh showed strong growth (37% and 8% respectively for online), and Finest outperformed with sales up 9%. The CEO's statement emphasizes strong performance against an uncertain external backdrop, indicating results beat internal and market expectations. Net debt improved to £(10,037)m, and the company increased share buybacks to £950m, reflecting confidence in sustained strong cash generation.
metrics_ahead: Adjusted operating profit up 6.3% at constant rates

results.headline: Preliminary Results for year ended 31 July 2026
results.key_quote: FY26 was another year of strong strategic and financial progress for Volution. We delivered organic growth despite a challenging market backdrop in particular in the UK, increased total revenue by 13.8% at constant currency, expanded adjusted operating margin by 90 basis points to 23.2%, successfully integrated Fantech and completed another attractive acquisition in AC Industries. We delivered adjusted earnings per share growth of 15.4%, further extending our compounding growth track record.
results.summary: Volution delivered materially ahead of expectations with strong earnings growth (adjusted operating profit +20.2%, adjusted EPS +15.4%), significant margin expansion (adjusted operating margin up 90bps to 23.2%, with UK margin up 230bps), and excellent cash conversion at 107%. The company demonstrated resilience with organic growth of 2.8% (constant currency) despite challenging UK market conditions, driven by strong Continental Europe (+5.9%) and Australasia (+3.3%) performance. ROIC increased to 25.4% despite acquisition activity. The CEO commentary emphasizes "strong strategic and financial progress" and extended compounding growth track record, with increased dividend up 18.5% demonstrating board confidence.
